name: Likhi
title: Descendant of Manasseh
summary: Likhi was a descendant of the tribe of Manasseh, mentioned in 1 Chronicles in a genealogy. He was the son of Shemida, who was one of Manasseh's descendants. Likhi is known only through his place in the genealogy and has no other recorded actions in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Manasseh's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Likhi is listed as one of the sons of Shemida in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh in 1 Chronicles.
